profile.headline: swe @ Meta
profile.summary:
Hi! I’m a Software Engineer at Meta with experience in backend development, trust and safety, and data analytics. I enjoy problem-solving and am interested in security, finance, and full-stack development.

Outside of work, I love traveling and snowboarding. I’m currently working on my tennis game. Feel free to reach out if you’d like to connect!

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborate with instructors, maintain weekly problem-solving sessions, and grade coursework for 80+ students
• Learn to better explain mathematical concepts and give detailed feedback to my students.

positions.title: Technology Consultant
positions.description:
• Provide on-the-job support for students, faculty, and staff with basic software, network, and printing problems.
• Assist senior consultants with answering phones and resolving online technical requests for 6 hours per week.

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Performed data quality checking, built monitoring dashboards for 2 AI projects using BigQuery
• Utilized R to implement regression models for network effects analysis on a 40-variable dataset and visualized the results using Excel
• Presented the results to senior leadership and investment partners, which received positive feedback and became metrics continuously maintained and driven by the product team

company.name: Công ty Cổ phần Nguồn Nhân Lực Siêu Việt - Sieu Viet Group

positions.title: Women Who Code Project
positions.description:
• Examine the roles of Python and SQL in data collection, preparation, and analysis.
• Extract, visualize, and interpret statistical data in the final project using Python.

positions.title: Virtual Job Shadowing Program
positions.description: Shadow a Principal Program Manager Lead at Microsoft in the daily work of developing products with the Data Analytics team and gain insight into the operation of the Engineering Groups at the company.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Mount Holyoke College Vietnamese Student Association (VSA)
• Maintain warehouse inventory and provide on-site support for a show that promotes Vietnamese culture and attracts 200+ people.
• Manage financial activities and request funding for 3 main events throughout the academic year.
